reviews.text:
My cat arrived for an emergency and was immediately seen. He had to be hospitalized and undergo surgery, and received all the necessary care.

Everyone at the clinic I dealt with was pleasant and helpful.

I understand the comments regarding a lack of flexibility with visits, hospitalization conditions, and staff presence during treatment; this is a reality. However, it's an emergency clinic, and this must be taken into account to put things in context, even though I admit it's not the ideal we imagine for our pets. There's a difference between the ideal and what's achievable given the resources available. I think they genuinely do their best.

Regarding the prices, however, if you want your care reimbursed, get pet insurance and plan ahead. Owning a pet is a responsibility; there's no social security coverage for animals, but it's not necessarily cheaper for humans.

Veterinary medicine is a very difficult profession in every respect; let's not forget that. For five days, I witnessed their 200% commitment to patient care. Show empathy; behind the white coat and the title, they are human beings!

Here's the short version for Crozatier:

> ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Thank you to the Crozatier Clinic and Dr. Pierre Daniel!

> My dog ​​hadn't been able to defecate for two months. You found the mass and operated on it. Today she's doing much better.

> Thank you also to the nurses, who were very gentle and attentive. I recommend them 100%.
Super

Just THANK YOU!!

💝💝💝💝💝 …

Thank you to the entire team at the Crozatier Clinic for taking such good care of my cat.

I would especially like to thank Dr. Lodarski for his professionalism, kindness, and the clarity of his explanations. He took the time to answer all my questions and clearly explain the situation and the treatment plan.

Thank you again to the whole team!

Thank you all for saving my cat Biggy!
The staff were amazing (everyone was there)!
So reassuring!
Biggy had surgery because he had eaten some rubber bands.
In the morning, I received a phone call with an update.
On the day of the operation, the surgeon called me to explain everything he had done.
Thank you, Doctor!
Biggy sends you all a big lick and promises he won't eat rubber bands anymore!
Thank you again!

★★★★★

We had to come in urgently for our rabbit, Cracotte, as our usual vet doesn't specialize in exotic pets. She had stopped eating, was listless in her cage, and her belly was swollen, mainly due to molting.

We were very warmly welcomed and reassured. The team quickly took Cracotte into their care, performed the necessary examinations, warmed her up, hydrated her, relieved her discomfort, and fed her via syringe.

She was able to go home a few days later and is now doing much better: she's eating, drinking, and using the toilet normally, and has regained her energy and curiosity. 🐰❤️

A huge thank you to the entire team for your kindness, professionalism, and prompt care, which greatly reassured us during this stressful time. We highly recommend this clinic! ❤️

Absolutely avoid this place.

It's not a clinic, it's a factory. The conditions for welcoming the public are deplorable, and the organization of services is disastrous. I can't comment on the quality of care, as I'm not a veterinarian; it was probably too late for my little Bengal. But because the overall organization is so appalling, I no longer even have confidence in the quality of care...

When I returned my pet after the first two days of hospitalization, there was no room available. The return took place in the waiting room amidst other people, constant movement, and general noise. The explanation of the necessary care and the lengthy report were therefore not provided in a suitable environment. And the total bill for the two hospitalizations was €2,000! Absolutely unbelievable!!! At that price, a minimum of consideration is expected, and a demonstration of how to administer the medication would have been welcome, but obviously impossible to do in the waiting room… it would require a room reservation system, undoubtedly too much to ask of such a poorly managed and organized clinic…

Animals undergoing treatment are kept in a room with constant noise and a constant stream of people passing by. The cat and dog kennels aren't partitioned, and I picked up my pet with fleas the first time.

There isn't follow-up by a single veterinarian, but by several who aren't necessarily aware of the situation. I had brought food I prepared myself because my Bengal doesn't tolerate commercial food (vomiting, diarrhea). The second time, they returned my little Bengal completely washed, and again with wet fur. Why? "She had diarrhea during the night, we had to wash her…" What do you mean, diarrhea? "Yes, we gave her some of the vet's food"??? “I told you not to give her commercial food, even if it’s formulated for intestinal problems…”

They didn’t give me back the t-shirt I’d brought for her either… anyway…

I had to have my cat readmitted to the hospital a few days later. I’d made an appointment for 5:00 PM (making it clear on the phone that I would have preferred 5:30 PM, but they told me that wasn’t possible because the last visits were at 5:00 PM). I arrived at 4:55 PM and went to reception. At 5:25 PM, after a 30-minute wait, still no news. I was still waiting. I had to insist to get an explanation: apparently, another visit was preventing me from seeing my cat. Why hadn’t they informed me and offered me another time slot? They told me to wait. I finally had to leave at 5:40 PM without having… I couldn't see my pet…
It's not a problem of available space, but rather of organization and coordination between the reception staff and the services behind the scenes. A simple chart would manage this kind of situation; it's unbelievable…

In short, this type of clinic, run by large groups, is a factory, with deplorable customer service, catastrophic organization of visits, and probably of follow-up care as well, because the vets aren't the same throughout…

The bill is exorbitant. In short, avoid at all costs and choose a better-organized, more humane clinic instead…
Thank you to the healthcare team.
Thank you so much to the team who took care of Ronron. I arrived in an emergency, and they took care of her immediately. Thank you so much for your kindness and professionalism.
A disgrace! This clinic is completely incompetent and overpriced. They made my cat wait six days for the results of his fine-needle aspiration. I'm taking legal action against them.

Don't go there for emergencies. My experience was very distressing. Each time, I encountered very compassionate staff who understood and took the time to listen to my concerns, but the mistakes made were too numerous and too serious for me not to take preventative measures.

Arriving in the middle of the night with my dog, the on-call vet found a foxtail in his ear. They tried to remove it, but it didn't work. The vet then suggested sedating him, which I agreed to. I left my dog, who was taken alone to a room. What followed were 30 rather traumatic minutes during which I heard him howling in pain. The on-call vet couldn't remove the foxtail, so the decision was made to leave him there overnight and perform a more advanced procedure the next day. I was told he would come in the morning, but it turned out my dog ​​would have to wait until 2 p.m. and I wouldn't get any updates on his condition. I called reception that morning, and they told me they couldn't give me any information.
That same night, I asked for a quote for the procedure scheduled for the next day. They gave me a rough estimate, which wouldn't be accurate the following day.
I told the on-call vet that my dog ​​was on antibiotics and that it was important they be given to him in the morning. She assured me that would be the case… well, no.
After the procedure, the surgeon called to inform me that nothing had been found and seemed surprised to learn that the on-call vet had seen a foxtail a few hours earlier. Between that and the fact that the antibiotics weren't given, I realized there was a serious problem, or even a complete lack of communication between the teams. I went to pick up my dog, paying over €500 (€123 for the emergency consultation + €412 for the surgery the next day). I was assured that since there was nothing wrong with his ear, he wouldn't have any further problems. The very next day, this proved false; my dog ​​was in pain and showed it to me. Unfortunately, no pain medication was prescribed.
A nurse called me the day after the surgery to ask how things were going. At the time, I was happy about the follow-up, especially since my dog ​​was still suffering. I told the nurse on the phone, and she assured me that she would pass everything on to the surgeon and that they would get back to me soon to determine if he needed to be brought back for another examination. I never received a response…

To be thorough about my experience, I want to clarify that the on-call vet was honest; I only paid for the emergency consultation with her since she wasn't able to remove the foxtail at the time.

Furthermore, I had the opportunity to speak with several people at the clinic, who were all very attentive. Unfortunately, this doesn't excuse the shortcomings; my dog ​​suffered unnecessarily, I believe, and is still suffering. If you can, go to a different emergency vet.

I came to the clinic in an emergency with my little rabbit, and I was quickly seen by lovely people! Everything went very well; my rabbit had to stay in the hospital for several days, and I received updates every morning, as well as clear explanations about my pet's condition. My rabbit was well cared for and came home in perfect health!
Before examining the animals, Dr. Fabienne Zeboulon takes the time to pet them to relax them. That's priceless.

This clinic ticks all the boxes for an excellent one. The welcome, attentive listening, clear explanations, follow-up, and prompt care are all evident, and you can feel a genuine love for animals. Our little cat received attentive care, and we were kept informed of her condition daily, including over the August 15th weekend. Since the clinic is open 24/7, I can only highly recommend it. Thank you to all the staff.

I am publishing under a pseudonym because I do not wish to expose my private life. All the facts recounted are based on my experience and are documented.

My cat was referred to Saint-Antoine Hospital and seen by Dr. Cervone for weight loss and intestinal thickening. During the initial consultation, before any tests were performed, he explained that, barring a recurrence of his hyperthyroidism, the diagnosis was either IBD or low-grade intestinal lymphoma.

I found his approach cold, mechanical, and rehearsed (which he later confirmed). My cat, very anxious at the vet's, physically trembled with fear for the first time. He also criticized my past dietary choices, even though I have always followed veterinary recommendations.

Part of the explanation took place in the hallway/waiting room. Dr. Cervone assured me that an endoscopy would provide a definitive diagnosis. I asked for confirmation: he confirmed it twice. He then said that I had misunderstood. Regarding the prognosis, to summarize: "In either case, she won't die." He confirms this.

Saint-Antoine first repeats the ultrasound performed a week earlier by his veterinarian, which reveals nothing new.

For the endoscopy, my cat, who had fasted since the previous day, is dropped off at 11:00 AM but isn't seen until 5:30 PM. Extremely stressed, not all the planned procedures can be performed. She vomits during the anesthesia and takes a week to recover.

Two weeks later, I receive an email requesting €200 for additional tests. I discover that in the case of lymphoma, the life expectancy would be 18 months to 3 years. Devastated, I ask to speak to Dr. Cervone. He refuses to call me back, asks me to send my questions by email, and makes me wait until Monday. However, the clinic calls me to collect the €200. When I finally spoke to him, I felt like I was talking to a lawyer concerned about protecting himself rather than a veterinarian.

Weeks went by. Despite my calls and promises of a callback, I had to retrieve the results myself and discovered they mentioned atypical lymphoma cells.

An intern finally called me back and presented the diagnosis as definitive: low-grade intestinal lymphoma, from which my cat would die, with a life expectancy of about two years. Saint-Antoine then prescribed chemotherapy to be started immediately.

Fortunately, I had made an appointment at a specialized oncology clinic.

Three days later, I learned that this diagnosis was far from certain. Three possibilities remained: IBD (therefore potentially no cancer), low-grade lymphoma, or high-grade lymphoma. To determine the cause with certainty, deeper biopsies via surgery would be necessary.

The invasive and expensive endoscopy, presented twice as a way to obtain a definitive diagnosis, was never the right examination.

I also learned that the blood test done at Saint-Antoine didn't include the analyses the oncologist now needs. This blood test had been incredibly distressing: Saint-Antoine refused to let me in, even though I'm the only one who can calm my cat, and I heard her howling from the next room. Now we have to do it all over again.

The total cost: nearly €3,000 and three months. A repeat ultrasound with no new findings, a blood test without the analyses now needed, an invasive endoscopy that didn't provide the promised definitive diagnosis, a cancer diagnosis presented as certain, and chemotherapy prescribed, only for an oncologist to tell me three days later that my cat might not even have cancer.

If your veterinarian needs to refer you elsewhere for further investigations, my advice is simple: whatever you do, don't go to the Saint-Antoine clinic.
Efficient and warm welcome, quality of care, I have been a client for years, I recommend this veterinary clinic.

I am satisfied with the vet who treats my Spitz, Ana.
He is attentive to the animal's health and not to money, unlike most other clinics and vets.
As president of a health association, I recommend this clinic and urge them to stay as they are and not hire vets who prioritize profit.

Because poor people cannot afford to care for their animals.
My little baby Tobby arrived in critical condition, is still hospitalized, and on an IV drip. Thank you for the excellent care he is receiving.

I'm very surprised by the reviews. I did come in for an emergency, and the quote was €1500, but for our animals, price is no object.

We tried three times to probe him; luckily, the third time was the charm because they told me point-blank that otherwise, "my cat would have died." Anyway, to make a long story short, I strongly advise against going to another vet because these ones will try to take your money, especially since they did everything they could to inflate the quote, and in the end, my cat left in even worse condition!
Very bad experience.
Highly competent staff, our animals are in good hands.

I came in for a scan for my rabbit, and the appointment went very well. The staff were very clear and attentive.

As an added bonus, I was able to pick up my rabbit very alert because he had only been given very light sedation, which was very reassuring.
I am very happy with the welcome and the explanations I received, and I left feeling reassured about both the procedure and his current condition. Thank you to the team and Dr. Huynh.

My family and I were deeply touched by the kindness, humanity, and empathy of the veterinarian. Thank you so much for taking such good care of our cat. Despite a busy and stressful schedule, the doctor is meticulous and reassuring. He shows them love while treating them. It's truly heartwarming and moving when you have a pet emergency.

Please know that this doesn't go unnoticed; we've talked about it several times since. Thank you so much for being so kind, thank you for your compassion ❤️

As a client of this clinic for over ten years, I've been dissatisfied several times: long waits despite booking appointments, animals treated like an assembly line, repeated incorrect diagnoses, and so on. For serious issues, I go to the Frégis clinic (more expensive consultations, but at least the diagnoses are accurate) or the Bellevue clinic in Autun (my parents have a house there, but unfortunately, I can't go every time because I live and work in Paris). However, today was the last straw: I brought my dog ​​in because I suspected he had a foxtail. I had to insist that my dog ​​be sedated in my presence (at Bellevue, they always sedate him with me; he sits peacefully on my lap). He was still as fresh as a daisy after 15 minutes (is it really that difficult to dose medetomidine or any other medication for an 8 kg dog?), but the vet still came to get him (you can't be with your pet even if they're just trimming their fur; again, it's like that everywhere else), and I heard him howling for 30 minutes. Of course, they still charge you for the sedation (which I never did at Bellevue either).

Between the lack of human presence with the animal, the shoddy care, and the poor diagnoses (I came three times for an ear problem that the different vets never diagnosed; I finally went to Fregis, and they found the problem right away; the same thing happened with a hernia diagnosed as arthritis, which was also treated at Fregis), I won't be going back there. I've lost all trust.

I recommend Frégis, or perhaps a clinic in the provinces where the vets take more time. If you're passing through Burgundy, go to Bellevue; the team is very kind, they offer you a coffee and leave you alone with your pet until it falls asleep!

Hello Marc,
We are delighted to see that you enjoyed your experience with our veterinary team! Thank you for taking the time to leave us a positive review.
Crozatier Veterinary Clinic - Referrals, Emergencies & 24/7 On-Call Services - Paris - Sevetys

On July 14th, I called the veterinary clinic for an emergency concerning my pet.
I was seen promptly and my pet was treated.
The veterinarian was very professional and compassionate.
I highly recommend this veterinary clinic.
Sincerely.
Well done and thank you to the entire team!
From Charli, my little dog, and myself.

Hello Hugues,
We are delighted to see that you enjoyed your experience with our veterinary team! Thank you for taking the time to leave us a positive review.
Crozatier Veterinary Clinic - Referrals, Emergencies & 24/7 On-Call Services - Paris - Sevetys
Like other reviews, this was a misdiagnosis and a waste of time/money. Our dog was correctly diagnosed the next day at the Fregis Veterinary Hospital.

I can't recommend the emergency vet highly enough—she's exceptional! Very kind, patient, and with excellent analytical skills, she takes the time for each animal, even at 4 a.m. One of the best vets I've ever met!

A huge thank you!

Hello Zaza,
Thank you for your positive review.
Crozatier Veterinary Clinic - Referrals, Emergencies & 24/7 On-Call Service - Paris - Sevetys

My cat has been a patient at this clinic for two years and everything has always gone well! The staff is welcoming, and the veterinarians are all competent and caring. The treatments offered are appropriate, and they don't try to charge us for excessive tests or treatments. The emergency service is also very good. I highly recommend them!

After receiving corticosteroids without a diuretic administered by a veterinarian at another Sevetys center, my 13-year-old cat developed respiratory distress. I went to the emergency room at the Crozatier center: the reception was cold, and my cat was placed on "oxygen" in a cage with what looked more like a vacuum cleaner hose than an oxygen supply. She was placed in a room with other cats in wire cages while a maintenance man was... vacuuming. Something's not right here, given how afraid cats are of those kinds of noises. I decided to take her out of there, and I learned from the bill that she had received an injection (...). Unfortunately, the damage was done, and despite the care, gentleness, and empathy of another emergency clinic in the 20th arrondissement, my cat died the next day. I absolutely do not recommend the Crozatier clinic.

A stressful arrival because my 16-year-old cat had been referred for further tests. Upon arrival, I waited, and two veterinarians came to see him. After discussion, it was agreed to bring him back on an empty stomach for ultrasounds and initial examinations, which were generally reassuring. By mutual agreement, I decided to have him operated on and returned the next day. The veterinarian gave me a report, and since then, two veterinarians have called to check on him, and another to explain the histology report. I acknowledge that all my cats have been treated at a small clinic for the past 17 years. The first time is always a question mark.

Furthermore, thanks to my health insurance, I don't have to pay any upfront costs at this clinic, which is a real plus in my case with the tests.
In addition, a few days later, several veterinarians called to check on him and answered my questions, and then a veterinarian came with the histology report.
Perhaps there's some administrative pressure; it's not always easy for them, especially to respond to requests in real time.

I can't say enough good things about the whole team!

My dog ​​Alba had a fever of over 40°C (104°F) for several days, with no improvement despite the treatments administered.

I dropped her off on Friday at noon, and she was immediately taken care of: blood tests, ultrasound, CT scan, and then emergency surgery. I received constant updates, and I was extremely well looked after and reassured throughout her hospitalization.

The cause was identified, and I was able to pick Alba up on Saturday evening. She is now slowly recovering.

Thank you again for the care she received, as well as for the attention, kindness, and professionalism you demonstrated throughout her treatment; it's priceless!

Superb clinic! They took great care of my little dog Onyx. He was in a terrible state after suffering severe bites from a Red Nose stinger.

A huge thank you to the entire team!
And happy holidays!
Prompt care was provided for my 14.5-year-old cat who had a very high heart rate and pulmonary edema.
Advice for anyone who loves and wants to save their pet
Very satisfied with the only Parisian clinic, to my knowledge, that treats new pets.

Absolutely avoid this clinic! Our vet requested emergency hospitalization for our cat after he contracted feline infectious peritonitis (FIP). Our vet specifically requested an emergency blood transfusion. Upon arriving at the Crozatier clinic, the on-call vet opted to duplicate tests already done to incur additional charges and determined that, although our cat was anemic, he didn't need a transfusion.

As a result, he died of cardiac arrest due to his anemia 24 hours later, even though he had every chance of survival. And they didn't even let us visit him before his death because it was a Sunday. We are devastated that this incompetence killed our 7-year-old cat! A real money-making machine! 1 star because it's not possible to give 0...

Hello Claire,
Thank you for your rating.
Crozatier Veterinary Clinic - Referrals, Emergencies & 24/7 On-Call Service - Paris - Sevetys

Hello,
I made an appointment at your veterinary clinic two days ago. On the day of the appointment, I was told I wasn't "on the schedule."
The next day, my pet died. My daughter had to watch her pet die, howling in pain. It's a terrible trauma for her and for our whole family.
I find the lack of seriousness and professionalism of your clinic unacceptable. When you work with animals and families, this kind of mistake can have dramatic consequences.
I am deeply shocked and disappointed by your behavior and your lack of consideration.

Hello Malik Hamiche,
We are delighted to know you were fully satisfied with your visit to our clinic!
Crozatier Veterinary Clinic - Referrals, Emergencies & 24/7 On-Call Services - Paris - Sevetys

Hello David,
We are delighted to see your excellent rating and wanted to thank you sincerely.

Have a lovely day,
Crozatier Veterinary Clinic - Referrals, Emergencies & 24/7 On-Call Services - Paris - Sevetys

Hello Ruby,
Thank you for your positive review.
Crozatier Veterinary Clinic - Referrals, Emergencies & 24/7 On-Call Services - Paris - Sevetys

My appointment was confirmed twice by phone the previous week, and despite this, after traveling there in the pouring rain, I was simply told at reception that the vet wasn't there.

No preparation, no call to let me know, no sincere apology. The only response I received was: "There's nothing we can do."

When I asked if it was possible to reschedule immediately to avoid this happening again, I was told I would have to call back myself later. When I asked how I could be guaranteed that it wouldn't happen again, the answer was: "I don't know."

Honestly, the level of disorganization and disregard for customers is quite astounding.

Unfortunately, this isn't an isolated incident. I have previously received medical reports riddled with errors and inconsistencies, which I had to point out myself by email to get corrections made. It is not the client's responsibility to proofread and correct medical documents.

Between the complete lack of organization, the absence of communication, the cold reception, and the lack of consideration shown to pet owners, this clinic hardly inspires confidence.

Very disappointing, both personally and professionally.
Excellent clinic, the staff are very professional and kind.

Hello Christine,
Thank you for your positive review.
Crozatier Veterinary Clinic - Referrals, Emergencies & 24/7 On-Call Services - Paris - Sevetys
Dr. Zebulon was extremely thorough in his search for a diagnosis for my little dog. THANK YOU

Hello Pascal Ruelle,
We are delighted to know you were fully satisfied with your visit to our clinic!
Crozatier Veterinary Clinic - Referrals, Emergencies & 24/7 On-Call Services - Paris - Sevetys

Hello Fabrice,
We are delighted to see your excellent rating and wanted to thank you sincerely.

Have a lovely day,
Crozatier Veterinary Clinic - Referrals, Emergencies & 24/7 On-Call Services - Paris - Sevetys

The one and only clinic I can trust completely! Their expertise and focus on the animal's well-being are paramount. I drive over an hour and a half every three months to entrust my dog ​​to Pierre and his team. My dog ​​is always happy to come and often stays for a few days for his care.

So thank you to the entire team, but especially Dr. Della Valle, Alexia, and Pierre!

I just got back from the clinic after an emergency with my rabbit, and honestly, the vet who specializes in exotic pets was really nice and took the time to explain all the treatments she was going to give my rabbit.
After all, you shouldn't skimp on the cost when you love your little furballs.

The rest of the team is also nice, at least everyone we dealt with.
Thank you for everything, and keep up the good work saving our animals. 👍❤️

I came in for my cat, who had been sick since early morning. We were able to get an emergency appointment despite the crowds. All the staff were incredibly attentive, kind, and listened carefully to what we had to say. Our concerns were addressed without judgment or disdain. It's truly evident that the staff love animals and take excellent care of them. Thank you!

Hello Johny Cash,
We are sorry that your visit to the clinic did not meet your expectations. We are constantly working to improve our service. You can contact us at 0143431713 to discuss this further.
Crozatier Veterinary Clinic - Referrals, Emergencies & 24/7 On-Call Services - Paris - Sevetys

A huge thank you again to Dr. Della Vanne and Dr. Chotard, as well as the entire clinic team, for saving my little dog Alfi, who arrived in critical condition as an emergency case.

The care my little Alfi received was exemplary. All the staff were incredibly attentive and compassionate, despite the urgency of the situation. You can tell they all truly love animals ❤️ Thank you from the bottom of my heart.

I was also able to visit him every day and spend time with him.

We brought our 15-year-old cat in at 8:30 pm on Sunday, March 22nd for an emergency. He received excellent care: examination, blood test results, and he was sent home with the medication. Thank you to the veterinarian and his assistant. Our cat recovered quickly!

Hello Helio,
We are delighted to see your excellent rating and wanted to thank you sincerely.

Have a lovely day,
Crozatier Veterinary Clinic - Referrals, Emergencies & 24/7 On-Call Services - Paris - Sevetys

My cat Marcel has been followed at the Crozatier clinic since January 2025 for recurring duodenal polyps and pancreatitis, and then, since January 2026, for the development of a malignant adenoma. Each time, the care has been effective, the diagnoses explained clearly, and the various treatments recommended. I was able to take the time to consider the necessary tests and investigations, and he has always received the best possible care. Marcel is doing well thanks to the treatment he has received. The entire team is kind and attentive, both during consultations and hospitalizations. I would especially like to thank Dr. Larrieu, his primary veterinarian.

My cat had surgery at this clinic after swallowing a piece of plastic. Everything went well, and he recovered perfectly. So, no complaints about the surgery itself. However, the surgeon ordered an intestinal biopsy, which we were, of course, charged for, and the results were supposed to be sent to us within 15 days. Three months later, we still hadn't received anything. We called twice, and the receptionist wasn't authorized to send results. Strange, right? The surgeon contacted us again to say there was nothing abnormal and would send us the results, which we requested. Nothing was ever sent. We're wondering if this examination actually took place. The examination is mentioned in the report, so it was billed, but there's no breakdown of the cost.

My dog ​​was hospitalized due to a complicated lung infection; she had a fever, was dehydrated, and malnourished. We were very worried, but she received exceptional care from the clinic team, and we were able to visit her every day. Special mention goes to Erin and Maëlle, who were incredibly welcoming, friendly, caring, and reassuring: their love for our furry friends is evident, and they do a remarkable job!

Thank you to the entire team at Sevetys Crozatier!

Thank you to Dr. Mennesson, the veterinary assistants, especially Erine, Maelle, and the others who helped Bouchon recover.
I highly recommend them for their compassion, understanding, and the time they dedicate to their patients!

My two-year-old dog is a patient at this clinic, and I sincerely thank them for all the care they provide. The welcome, the follow-up care, and the kindness of the staff are undoubtedly key strengths! I highly recommend them!!

On the recommendation of my cat's veterinarian, I went to the Crozatier Veterinary Clinic, and the 5 stars are well deserved: from the initial welcome to the accuracy of the diagnosis and the quality of the emergency procedure my cat needed, everything was handled with tact, compassion, and efficiency. Since then, I've already passed on their contact information to all my friends who have dogs or cats. I needed follow-up on a medication regimen, and again, the response was quick and clear—thank you.

My experience with this clinic was very disappointing. My little Spitz suffered from misdiagnosis, and despite observed seizures, we were offered a skeletal X-ray and unnecessary tests. The result: a traumatized dog kept for two hours and a bill of nearly 600 euros. Furthermore, they confused my dog's name with that of my other dog. We were also offered an additional scan, further increasing the costs. After filing complaints and explaining the situation, it's astonishing that the clinic has a high rating despite several complaints. Isn't there any oversight from the health authorities? Everything is designed to rip off clients!

I had to rush my dog ​​to the vet on a Sunday evening because he'd come into contact with a processionary caterpillar. The vet diagnosed poisoning, even though I had rashes after contact with my dog. He was hospitalized for 24 hours, where they took a blood sample, performed an ultrasound, and gave him activated charcoal. I picked him up the next day in a terrible state, starving and filthy, with a bill for over €1000! He wasn't treated for the caterpillar. The following day, given his condition, I was forced to rush him back to my regular vet: she confirmed the diagnosis and also mentioned that he had a fever of 40°C (104°F). Luckily, this vet is amazing; she saved my dog. This clinic is to be avoided at all costs; they're only in it for the money.

Excellent care for our Cavalier King Charles Spaniel, Jazz; he's doing much better and we're so relieved!

They are attentive and very dedicated to their work. A big thank you to the whole team.
A team that listens, with great competence and expertise.

Avoid this clinic at all costs. I paid €300 for a blood test for my diabetic cat, and instead of relieving his suffering, they wanted to hospitalize him for €1000. Now he's even worse. And there's nothing I can do. He can't eat. I'm forced to go to another vet. It's a money grab, a disgrace. Run away!

This clinic is to be avoided at all costs!!!
It's shameful, as if our animals are just a walking wallet for them... and they turn a blind eye to their well-being and health!
Operations that only worsened our pet's health, botched diagnoses that weren't taken seriously... We informed them of a health issue our pet had after observing him. The vet told us that wasn't the case at the time... and then, based on the consequences, told us that it was indeed the case; he had detected the problem.
Today, our dog could still be with us.
We are devastated by his sudden passing and disappointed with this clinic that only cares about money!!!

I don't usually leave reviews, but this is unacceptable.
